description: A test for an unimplemented feature marked with pytest.mark.xfail, so the suite does not fail on it and the marker is easy to find later.

steps.description: This shows how to skip an unimplemented feature cleanly. The page says to use `pytest.skip` or `pytest.mark.xfail` rather than commenting out the test.
`@pytest.mark.xfail(reason="list literals not yet implemented", strict=True)` marks the test as expected to fail and records the reason.
`test_list_literal` checks that `run("[1, 2, 3]")` gives `[1, 2, 3]`. The page says to remove the marker once the feature ships.

steps.question: The page says `strict=True` means the test suite fails if the test unexpectedly does what?

title: Marking a Test xfail
